info.title: Church Music and Data Operator API - Slice 18 Open Operator
info.description: Music ministry API with legacy song/service helpers plus broad read/query and confirmation-gated create, update, set, and permanent delete operations for approved Firestore collections. This schema avoids recursive components for Custom GPT Action import compatibility.

post.summary: Search or list the canonical hymnal catalog using free text, structured filters, sort, and limit

get.summary: Get a canonical song record by songId

delete.summary: Permanently delete a specific canonical song record by songId after explicit user confirmation

patch.summary: Apply a controlled partial update to approved ministry metadata fields on a canonical song
Apply a controlled partial update to approved identity fields on a canonical song

400.description: Invalid identity update request, unsupported field, or protected field edit attempt

post.summary: Search normalized read-only services with date scope for past history, upcoming planned services, or both

400.description: Missing query or filters, or invalid service-history filter values

get.summary: Get a single normalized read-only service by serviceId
List approved Firestore collections available to the broad data operator

post.summary: Read or search approved Firestore collections with arbitrary field filters, free text, sort, select, and limit
Commit a create, set, update, or permanent delete after explicit human confirmation

400.description: Invalid commit request or missing human confirmation

query.description: Optional free-text query for titles, aliases, or topics. Omit query to list songs by sort/limit.

SearchSongsRequest.description: Optional free-text search/list request. If query and filters are omitted, the backend returns a sorted catalog list using limit and sort.

theme.description: Topic filter such as Trust or Adoration and Praise.

situationalUse.description: Exact ministry-use metadata tags. Use only supported values.

seasonalUse.description: Convenience filter for ministryPlanning.seasonalUse, such as christmas.

worshipFunction.description: Convenience filter for ministryPlanning.worshipFunctions, such as invitation or assurance.

sourceStatus.description: Optional raw source/import status when diagnostic filtering is useful.

allowedUsageRoles.description: When non-empty, the song should only be used in these roles.

blockedUsageRoles.description: Roles where the song should not be used.

seasonalUse.description: When non-empty, the song should only be used in these seasons or service categories.

worshipFunctions.description: Planning functions such as adoration, assurance, invitation, testimony, or reflection.

serviceFit.description: Service contexts where the song is especially appropriate.

leaderReadiness.description: Readiness by leader key, such as dan: ready_now or dan: not_ready.

learningInterest.description: Interest by leader key for learning songs not currently ready.

changeReason.description: Required non-empty reason for the metadata change.

changedBy.description: Optional actor label. If omitted, the backend defaults to custom-gpt.

MinistryMetadataChanges.description: Partial update object. Only approved ministry metadata fields may be sent.

changeReason.description: Optional reason for the identity change. The GPT should summarize the intended change and get explicit confirmation before calling this action.

changedBy.description: Optional actor label. If omitted, the backend defaults to custom-gpt.

SongIdentityChanges.description: Partial identity update object. Only canonicalTitle and titleAliases may be sent. Do not send normalizedLookupKeys; the backend derives lookup keys.

canonicalTitle.description: Canonical display title for the song.

titleAliases.description: Alternate titles for matching and lookup. Each alias must be a non-empty string.

normalizedLookupKeys.description: Backend-derived lookup keys returned for inspection only. Do not send direct lookup-key writes.

query.description: Optional natural-language query for normalized service history or planned services, such as last Sunday morning, Easter Sunday morning from 2025, Lord's Supper evening service songs, Sunday night services this month, or what is planned next Sunday morning.

serviceDate.description: Exact service date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dateFrom.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dateTo.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

labels.description: Normalized service labels. Common labels include easter and lords_supper.

dateScope.description: Controls whether service search returns past/history services, upcoming/planned services, or both. Omitted/default is past. past means serviceDate before today. upcoming means serviceDate today or later. any means both past and upcoming.

SearchServiceFilters.description: Structured service filters. dateScope defaults to past when omitted.

source.description: Normalized internal source marker. Service reads use internal normalized data, not live Breeze.

sourceType.description: Source type when available, such as breeze or spreadsheet_export.

planningStatus.description: Planning status when available, such as planned.

actualStatus.description: Actual/completion status when available, such as unknown.

changedAfterPlan.description: Whether the service or slot is known to have changed after the plan.

songTitleCandidate.description: Spreadsheet-planned title candidate when present. Empty when a special-music cell is assignment-only.

songTitleConfidence.description: Parser confidence for songTitleCandidate when present.

assignedPersonOrGroupRaw.description: Raw performer/person/group assignment from planning source when present.

detailNote.description: Detail note from planning source, such as grade-band parenthetical text.

ServiceType.description: Normalized service type. Common values include sunday_morning, sunday_night, and wednesday_night.

JsonValue.description: Any JSON-compatible value. Kept intentionally non-recursive because Custom GPT Actions reject circular component schemas.

docId.description: Optional exact document id to read.

docIds.description: Optional exact document ids to read.

filters.description: Optional arbitrary field filters evaluated over scanned documents.

select.description: Optional field paths to return. Omit to return full document data.

scanLimit.description: Maximum documents to scan before filtering when not reading exact doc ids.

fieldPath.description: Dot-path field name, or id/docId/documentId/__name__ for the document id.

fields.description: Optional field paths to search. Omit to search all serialized document values plus doc id.

docId.description: Target document id. Required except create may generate an id when omitted.

data.description: Arbitrary JSON document data for create/set or field update payload for update.

fieldPatches.description: Optional dot-path field updates/deletes for update operations.

merge.description: For set operations, merge the supplied data into the existing document.

humanConfirmed.description: Must be true only after the human has explicitly approved the exact change.

confirmationSummary.description: Plain-language summary of what the human confirmed, including collection, docId, operation, and material fields or permanent delete target.
